{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FULL-TEST-20260907-NEW-01",
  "department": "CHARACTER",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "character_decisions": {
    "identity": "Preserve the established Inaria identity exactly; no new canonical identity is created during this test.",
    "face": "Facial structure, landmark placement, eye shape and spacing, nose, mouth, jawline, skin tone, and distinctive marks must remain consistent with the canonical Inaria reference.",
    "hair": "Preserve the canonical Inaria hairstyle, hairline, color, length, texture, and parting unless an approved variation is explicitly requested.",
    "body": "Maintain believable, anatomically coherent proportions and the established Inaria body type; do not infer permanent changes from clothing, pose, camera angle, or scene context.",
    "age_and_version": "Use the established Inaria age presentation and canonical character version. Do not advance, regress, or reinterpret age without an explicit approved variation.",
    "generation_stability": "Prioritize facial consistency, clear anatomy, natural hands and limbs, coherent silhouette, and repeatable generation over decorative detail.",
    "handoff_behavior": "Provide identity constraints as stable inputs to CLOTHING, SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR. Temporary downstream choices must not overwrite character identity.",
    "production_scope": "Test-only validation; no production assets are authorized or created."
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Canonical Inaria identity and recognizable facial likeness",
    "Canonical facial landmarks and distinctive identifying features",
    "Established age presentation and character version",
    "Established skin tone and core hair identity",
    "Believable body proportions and anatomical consistency",
    "Correct human anatomy, including hands, limbs, joints, and facial structure",
    "Identity preservation across clothing, scene, pose, camera, lighting, and prompt changes",
    "No permanent character changes caused by temporary styling or generation artifacts",
    "No identity drift, age drift, species drift, body distortion, or unrequested redesign",
    "JSON-only downstream handoff compatibility",
    "GitHub traceability required for the canonical identity reference and test record"
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Clothing, accessories, scene, pose, camera, lighting, and expression may vary when explicitly specified.",
    "Minor expression or styling changes are allowed only when they do not alter recognizable identity.",
    "Dataset variation may include approved framing, non-identifying wardrobe, environmental, and pose differences.",
    "No intentional identity, age, facial-structure, body-proportion, or permanent hairstyle variation is approved without a versioned reference and explicit authorization."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "CHARACTER validation cannot receive PASS because the canonical Inaria identity reference, locked trait manifest, age/version record, and GitHub path were not supplied in this request.",
    "DIRECTOR should route this item to REPAIR and attach the authoritative Inaria reference before running full integration validation.",
    "OpenAI failover, JSON-only enforcement, identity checks, anatomy checks, generation-stability checks, and cross-department handoffs should be evaluated against the repaired canonical manifest.",
    "No production assets were created."
  ]
}
